chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from Abi Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام: “As for recitation in the salat (prayer), is there anything fixed in it?” He said: “No, except in الجمعة, in which al-Jumu'ah and al-Munafiqun are recited.”

key_terms.ٱلْجُمُعَةِ: Friday prayer, and also the surah al-Jumu'ah in context
key_terms.ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ: Surah al-Munafiqun, designated here for recitation in Friday prayer

ai.seo_question: Is there a fixed surah to recite in Friday prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that there is no specifically fixed recitation for salat (prayer) in general. An exception is made for the Friday prayer, in which Surah al-Jumu'ah and Surah al-Munafiqun are to be recited, indicating a particular recommended or prescribed recitational practice for that occasion.
